_comment: Maintenance delta from published v0.8.1 (4f8d117517c2488fd4357be8089c09f488e18121) to
inspected main ac678db689a1faf2eb098d0027fc7d176a362d00 consists of the #979/#980
Architecture Health badge temporal-publication correctness fix. The actual release candidate
source is the reviewed preparation merge SHA, not a publisher workflow/action pin.
The fix preserves PR-produced Health/Gate/counts/payload authority and revalidates only
time-sensitive serialized publication evidence for the exact unchanged merged tree when the
original UTC semantic horizon has elapsed. Expired, stale, invalid, mismatched or otherwise
unverifiable temporal evidence remains fail-closed; a UTC-midnight crossing during revalidation
is retried only through the same canonical revalidation path, never by arbitrary lease extension.
Private Relay remains experimental / opt-in. #922/#834/#836/#825 are intentionally deferred
until after v0.8.2 and do not block this public github-raw correctness patch. Their code is not
subtracted from packages and experimental status does not waive security/privacy/integrity defects.
#806 remains release authority; #976/#977 and milestone closure must not authorize themselves.
No unrelated v0.9 performance or next-minor capability is included in this patch candidate.
